transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Well, I came in because... I know the people at my apartment building are watching my comings and goings. They're slipping notes about me to the front office. Everybody keeps telling me it's just, you know, regular notices left on the doors, but I know what they're really doing.
Have you had any periods when your mood was unusually high or very irritable?
No, I can't say that I have. I don't really get... you know, high or energetic like that. I haven't noticed any periods where I felt unusually good or anything, no.
How long have you been having these beliefs that people are watching you and sending notes about you?
Well, I'd say... it's been going on for a while now. About a year and a month, I think. That's when I really started noticing the suspicious stuff with the neighbors and the office.
Before this started, have you generally been suspicious or mistrustful of other people?

No, not really. I mean, I've always been a pretty private person, but I never thought people were out to get me or anything. Not until all this stuff started happening at the building. Before that, I just... I just kept to myself, but I didn't think anyone was watching me.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t seem to notice?

No, I haven't. I mean, I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. It's just... it's just the things I actually see them doing, like the notes and the watching. But no, no strange voices or visions or anything like that.
Since these concerns began, have you had any trouble keeping up with work, school, or day-to-day responsibilities?

Yeah, it has been hard. I've fallen behind on my bills, and... well, I've missed a few appointments, too. I even stopped showing up for church and the volunteer commitments I had. I just can't seem to keep my days organized anymore. Plus, I just don't trust ordinary interactions with people right now, so it's easier not to go out and do those things.
Before this began, did you tend to prefer being alone and keep emotionally distant from other people?

No, I wouldn't say that. I mean, I know I just said I've always been a private person, but I didn't shut people out completely. I had friends, and I liked talking to folks at church and things like that. I wasn't cold or distant... I cared about the people in my life. It's really just been recently that I've wanted to be completely alone.
Have you ever heard a voice when no one else was around?
No, like I said a minute ago, I don't hear any voices. I've never heard anyone talking to me when I'm by myself. It's just the stuff I see people doing, not voices.
Have you noticed any times when your thoughts or speech have felt very disorganized or hard for other people to follow?

Yeah, I have noticed that. It seems like when I try to explain things to folks lately, they get confused. I'll start off talking about the rent, and then I'll mention the marina, then the choir robes and the wires in the walls. People just look at me like I skipped half the story. It makes sense to me when I'm saying it, but I guess they can't follow how I got from one thing to the next.
Have you ever heard voices that other people could not hear?

No, like I was just saying a minute ago, I don't hear any voices. Nobody is talking or whispering to me that other folks can't hear. Like I said, it's just the things I see going on, but I'm not hearing things.
Have you noticed yourself becoming much less motivated or less able to feel pleasure in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I have. I used to really look forward to things, you know? Like going to choir practice, playing bridge, cooking up a pot of beans on Sundays, or even just doing little repair jobs for folks. But lately... I just don't care about any of it. I mostly just let the phone ring when people call. I just tell myself there is no point in going or doing anything anymore.
When you talk with other people now, do they often have trouble understanding what you mean because your speech gets hard to follow?

Well, like I was saying a few minutes ago... yeah, they do. I guess I already mentioned that, but folks definitely get confused when I talk lately. I try to explain something and they just look at me like they lost the thread of the whole conversation. So, yeah, they do have trouble following me.
About how long have you been having the trouble with your thinking and speech becoming hard for other people to follow?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. It's hard to put an exact timeline on it. I just know it's been happening for a while now, where people just can't seem to keep up with what I'm trying to say.
Have your beliefs ever been about something other than people watching or targeting you, or have they stayed focused on this same issue the whole time?

No, it's pretty much stayed on that same issue the whole time. That's actually why I came in... I just know the people at my apartment are watching my comings and goings. They keep slipping notes about me to the office. Everybody keeps telling me it's just regular notices they tape on the doors, but I know what they're doing. So, yeah, it's really just been focused on that.
Before this started, were you able to work and manage your daily life about as well as most people your age?

Yeah, I used to manage just fine, same as anybody else. But since this started... well, things have really gone downhill. I've fallen way behind on my bills, and I keep missing my appointments. I even stopped showing up for church and the volunteer work I used to do. I just can't seem to keep my days organized anymore. And honestly, I just don't trust ordinary interactions with people right now, so it's hard to keep up with any of it.
Have you believed that any outside force or group is controlling your thoughts or actions?
No, I don't think so. It's just the people watching me at the apartment. I haven't felt like anyone is actually controlling my thoughts or anything like that. Just... keeping an eye on me.
Have you also believed that the people at your apartment are controlling or putting thoughts into your mind?

No, no, nothing like that. Like I said, I don't feel like anyone's putting thoughts in my head or controlling what I do. They're just watching me, keeping tabs on me and trying to get me in trouble with the office. My thoughts are my own.
Have these beliefs and the trouble with your thinking made it harder for you to do your usual work or daily tasks than you were able to before?

Yeah, it really has. Like I mentioned before, I've fallen way behind on my bills and I keep missing my appointments. I just can't seem to keep my days organized anymore. And I've stopped going to church and doing my volunteer work. It's just... I don't trust ordinary interactions with people right now, with everything going on. So it's made doing my usual stuff a lot harder than it used to be.
Do other people around you share this belief that the apartment building staff and neighbors are watching and sending notes about you?

No, they don't. I mean, nobody else seems to see it. When I've tried to tell my family or... or the few people I still talk to, they just tell me I'm imagining things. They don't believe me at all. They think it's all in my head.
Have these beliefs and the trouble with your thinking been present continuously for at least six months?

Yes, it's been a lot longer than six months. This has been going on for about a year and five months now. It all started right after I left the house I shared with my wife and moved into this senior apartment building. That's when all this began.
